policy_presence.summary: Retained public Claims show scoped institutional material. Currentness and complete policy coverage remain PARTIAL.

ai_disclosure.summary: askUWA records say to reference AI-generated assessment content and note that tools and prompts may be requested. Disclosure does not replace the Unit Coordinator’s permission.

coursework.summary: The retained record requires the Unit Coordinator’s explicit permission and acknowledgement for assessed AI use. Its three-tier guide and editorial-assistance limits need current source confirmation; do not infer general permission.

exams.summary: The retained Tier1 record prohibits AI in tasks assigned that tier. Whether a particular exam uses that tier is not established here; check its actual instructions and the unrecovered guide.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Retained student and library records caution against personal data and university intellectual property in public AI. The 2026 guide source is missing; confirm the operative restrictions before uploading course material.

academic_integrity.summary: The existing integrity record classifies AI-generated assessment material within plagiarism rules. Read it with task permission and disclosure conditions; the discipline regulations effective September2026 need separate procedure review.

approved_tools.summary: DeepSeek blocking and avoidance statements remain recorded, with current-guide gaps. Copilot’s enterprise research-data status does not establish student eligibility, seats, cost or assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Named services in retained Claims are discovery context only; eligibility and assessment permission remain unverified.

teaching_guidance.summary: The retained guide describes three task-specific AI tiers selected by lecturers. It does not assign a tier to your unit or exam, and the original2026 guide was not recovered.

research_guidance.summary: Research-writing records reject AI authorship and call for transparent disclosure. Authors remain responsible for suitable inputs, privacy, copyright, ethics and data sensitivity; the full current source is still unverified.

security_procurement.summary: The retained security record says DeepSeek is blocked on UWA-managed devices and networks. This does not prove approval of alternative tools or unrestricted personal-device use.
